SELECT 
    o.opsregistry,
    f.budgetallotusd,
    f.ops_costs_usd,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(f.budgetallotusd, '$', ''), ',', '')::real - f.ops_costs_usd as remaining
FROM financials f
JOIN operations o ON o.opsregistry = f.fin_ops_ref
WHERE f.funding_state = 'Critical'
  AND REPLACE(REPLACE(f.budgetallotusd, '$', ''), ',', '')::real < f.ops_costs_usd
ORDER BY remaining ASC;

SELECT 
    o.opsregistry,
    f.budgetallotusd,
    f.ops_costs_usd,
    CURRENT_DATE - o.ops_start_date as days_since_start,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(f.budgetallotusd, '$', ''), ',', '')::real as budget,
    (REPLACE(REPLACE(f.budgetallotusd, '$', ''), ',', '')::real - f.ops_costs_usd) as remaining_budget,
    f.ops_costs_usd / (CURRENT_DATE - o.ops_start_date)::numeric as daily_burn,
    CASE WHEN f.ops_costs_usd = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(CAST(
        (REPLACE(REPLACE(f.budgetallotusd, '$', ''), ',', '')::real - f.ops_costs_usd) / 
        (f.ops_costs_usd / (CURRENT_DATE - o.ops_start_date)::numeric) 
    AS numeric), 2) END as runway
FROM operations o
JOIN financials f ON o.opsregistry = f.fin_ops_ref
WHERE f.funding_state = 'Critical'
ORDER BY runway ASC;

    o.opsregistry,
    f.budgetallotusd,
    f.ops_costs_usd,
    COALESCE(SUM(h.staffcostsusd), 0) as hr_costs,

LEFT JOIN humanresources h ON h.hr_ops_ref = o.opsregistry
WHERE f.funding_state = 'Critical'
GROUP BY o.opsregistry, f.budgetallotusd, f.ops_costs_usd
